name: Solargraf
headline: Solargraf — normalized financing inside solar proposals
summary: Solargraf is a PV design and proposal engine that aggregates multiple lenders into a standardized FinancialOptionsResponse — so enterprise apps can read GoodLeap (loanpal), Mosaic, Bank of Montreal, Service Finance, Enfin, and others without integrating each API.

key_facts.label: Role
key_facts.value: Design + proposal platform with multi-lender financing schema

key_facts.label: Permissions
key_facts.value: Parent-child company hierarchies on API tokens

sections.heading: Why installers use aggregators
sections.body: Direct integrations with every lender are expensive to build and maintain. Solargraf already completed that engineering, then exposes project design, localized pricing, and standardized financing data through its Developer API.

sections.heading: FinancialOptionsResponse — the useful schema
sections.body: The schema encapsulates solar finance math that homeowners feel as “monthly payment” lines. Core properties include type, financingType (lender key such as loanpal or mosaic), amount, rate, rateEscalator (critical for leases/PPAs), dealerFeeAmount, and tiers[] for multi-phase payments after ITC-style checkpoints.

table.caption: Selected FinancialOptionsResponse fields
rows: Upfront fee charged to the dealer — drives true margin and often your financed total
Multi-phase payments (e.g. step-up after month 16–18 if a tax-credit principal paydown never arrives)

sections.heading: Webhooks around the proposal lifecycle
sections.body: Integrators subscribe to events such as proposal_details_updated, proposal_signed, and signed_pdf_generated so CRMs stay in sync when homeowners e-sign. That is how a PDF in your inbox and a job in the installer’s Ops board stay aligned.

sections.heading: How to use this as a homeowner
sections.body: Ask for the financing type, dealer fee amount, and any tiers on the Solargraf (or similar) proposal export. If rateEscalator is non-zero, you are probably looking at a lease/PPA — model ownership vs third-party carefully, especially with 2026 federal 25D changes for cash/loan buys.

questions_to_ask: Which financingType/lender sits behind each option on my proposal?
What is dealerFeeAmount in dollars, and is it in my principal?
Do tiers[] assume a tax credit I may not receive in 2026?
red_flags: Lease/PPA escalator not disclosed next to year-1 payment.
Dealer fee hidden while cash price is called “same as financed.”

faqs.question: Is Solargraf a lender?
faqs.answer: No. It is design/proposal software that aggregates and normalizes financing options from lenders.

faqs.question: What does loanpal mean on my PDF?
faqs.answer: It is a common schema key for GoodLeap’s lineage. Confirm the consumer product name with your installer.
